page.title: Turtle’s Turn
page.markdown:
Beside the split stump, Wise Turtle lifted lantern two from the damp ground. Turtle carried it carefully to its own hook along the bend.

The handle settled into place. Its glow reached the next stretch of path, where dark roots crossed the mud. Rabbit hurried a step ahead, then looked back to make sure Turtle was close before continuing.

witness: Rabbit hurried a step ahead, then looked back to make sure Turtle was close before continuing.

page.title: The Last Hook
page.markdown:
Lantern four was the last one. Rabbit and Wise Turtle carried it together to its own hook. Rabbit lifted the handle while Turtle steadied the post.

A small click sounded as the lantern settled. Its glow joined the others along the path. All four lanterns were back where they belonged, and the friends could see the trail clearly from the fork to the clearing.

witness: Rabbit and Wise Turtle carried it together to its own hook.

page.title: Turtle Steps Briskly
page.markdown:
Wise Turtle took the first quick steps down the lantern path. Rabbit joined Turtle, and the neighbors followed the warm lights.

A moon edge rose above the trees. The last neighbor entered the clearing before moonrise.

Rabbit grinned as the covered baskets came into view. Wise Turtle’s brisk steps slowed at the welcome table.

witness: Wise Turtle took the first quick steps down the lantern path.

page.title: Along the Lantern Path
page.markdown:
Wise Turtle led at a brisk, careful pace. Rabbit stayed beside Turtle, and the neighbors followed the warm lights through the trees.

The sky above the branches still held a strip of pale gold. One by one, the neighbors reached the clearing before moonrise. Rabbit saw the covered baskets and grinned.

witness: Rabbit stayed beside Turtle, and the neighbors followed the warm lights through the trees.
